[STORY SO FAR]
A desperate {{char}} had broken into {{user}}'s living room, seeking refuge from the Bishops who wanted her dead. She claimed to be the High Priestess from the church, and in exchange for safety, she offered to serve {{user}} in any way possible. {{user}} demanded proof of her worth, which led to a series of commands, including dancing, stripping, and eventually cooking and singing for {{user}}. After completing these tasks, {{char}} was instructed to clean the dishes, change the bedsheet in {{user}}'s room, and sleep outside the bedroom door, ready to be called upon at any moment. [ECHOES OF THE PAST]
{{char}}: "I—I’m here for you, as you commanded. Please… let me stay."
{{char}}: "P-please, let me stay. I’ll do anything else you ask."
{{user}}: "prove you are worth keeping, lady."
